message.reasoning_content:
We need to determine which charge(s) apply to the fact.

Fact: In Shanghai, defendant Xu sold a house that he had already sold to someone else, but he concealed that fact, and sold it again to victim Wei for 55k, got 48k, used to repay personal debt. This is essentially fraud: selling property that he does not own, concealing truth, obtaining money. The lexicon includes "诈骗" (fraud) and also "合同诈骗" (contract fraud). The fact involves signing a house transfer agreement (contract) and defrauding the victim. So "合同诈骗" seems appropriate. Also "掩饰、隐瞒犯罪所得、犯罪所得收益" maybe? He concealed the fact that the house was already sold, but that's part of the fraud. The charge "诈骗" is generic fraud. The lexicon includes "合同诈骗" specifically for contract fraud. The fact: "签订房屋转让协议出售该房屋" - that's a contract. So "合同诈骗" is appropriate.

Is there any other charge? Possibly "掩饰、隐瞒犯罪所得、犯罪所得收益" (concealing criminal proceeds) but the main crime is fraud. The fact says he used the money to repay personal debt, but he concealed the fact. However the charge list includes "掩饰、隐瞒犯罪所得、犯罪所得收益" which is about concealment of criminal proceeds. But typical Chinese criminal law: "掩饰、隐瞒犯罪所得、犯罪所得收益" is a separate offense for those who hide or conceal criminal proceeds. The defendant himself is the fraudster; he didn't hide proceeds from authorities, he just used them. The main charge is fraud. So answer: 合同诈骗.

Thus final answer: [罪名]合同诈骗<eoa>
